description: Load screening workflow to find, filter, scan, rank stocks, top N by.... REQUIRES get_database_schema then get_query_patterns to be called first (in that order). Call BEFORE writing SQL when the user asks to find, screen, scan, rank, or filter stocks — "find stocks that...", "top 10 by...", "best dividend stocks", value/growth screens, sector ranking, or any multi-factor selection. Can be combined with other workflow tools.
name: load_screening_workflow
title: Stock Screening Workflow
